name: scare
desc:
One creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a  DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.
One creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice within 20 ft. of it must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.
